extension.summary: Movies and TV shows from user-configured M3U feeds
extension.description: Appi reads a movie M3U feed and paged TV-show M3U feeds, stores a persistent local catalogue, supports text search, and passes the original media URL to Kodi for playback.
extension.news: 0.4.0 - Faster batched directory loading, compact playback references, Kodi sort methods, direct ZIP installation from the Pages source, and TV Show > Season > Episode navigation.

extension.summary: Repository for the Appi Kodi add-on
extension.description: Installs and updates Appi from the ihabmmali/appi GitHub repository.
